population: worker_leases role IN (checker, security_checker), runtime NOT manual, status IN (completed, failed); manual reviewers (no model) excluded

definitions.valid_verdict: status completed AND verdict IN (accepted, needs_revision, rejected) parsed from the reviewer output; never inferred
definitions.tokens: runtime_usage.total_tokens = sum over opencode steps of (input + cache read + output); equals the per-step sum on every lease with stdout
definitions.independent_label: merge_survival settled (survived/regressed) only; a PR merge or the run gates are not independent of the verdict; operator_label judgments cover no reviewer subject
